hardware.network: same-host mlx5 RDMA and loopback HTTP/TCP

server.implementation: development MinIO build with cuObject support

client.registration: DMA-BUF, two caller-owned host buffers reused

method.order: TCP first for repeats 0 and 2, cuObject first for repeat 1
method.summary: median per mode/size/operation, then ratio of medians

CPU_scope: CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID inside measured loops; excludes initialization, registration, preparation, verification, other processes and kernel work not charged to this process
limitations: shared host with uncontrolled background activity
no colocated application or CPU-quota experiment
